resolved.evidence: pq1 is rewritten as specified. The AI now makes one sound remark and one wrong one: 「Mustは「品物の追加」と「お店ごとの並べ替え」です。AIは2つとも「Shouldでもよいかもしれません」と指摘しました」. The correct option a 「並べ替えだけShouldに移し、品物の追加はMustに残す」 no longer carries the recap's criterion, so it cannot be matched by wording. Misconception 1 is now a graded distractor: b 「AIの指摘どおり、2つともShouldに移す」 has the feedback 「品物を追加できないと、メモが作れず目的を果たせません。指摘は1つずつ、目的に照らして確かめます。」. A learner who simply follows the AI now gets pq1 wrong. objectiveId o3 and bloom evaluate are kept.

There is no trivia, and the answer is not given away. The club-app model answer later resolves the same six features.

prerequisites names 「第2章｜AIと企画する力を身につける」. practice-recap recalls MoSCoW from ch2, with a citation. The glossary repeats 壁打ち, MoSCoW and 1枚企画書, and p-interview glosses 壁打ち inline. No new terms are introduced.

Lint is clean, and the body (about 2,038 chars per the brief) is within 2,400. The practice is split into three one-idea sections. practice-plan stacks seven blocks: steps, prompt, tip, diagram, a 7-item checklist and a quiz. p-revise's 「下のチェックリスト」 sits four blocks below it.

The fully worked budget-app example lives in the prerequisite vibe-ch2. This lesson gives a club-app model with reasons (「理由の例：イベントの作成は「出欠を聞く場がないと始まらないから」」) in practice-prompt.expect and practice-prompt-plan.expect, plus the practice-flow diagram. These are collapsed and pointed to by practice-tip, so learners attempt first and compare after. That is acceptable for a practice lesson, but the revise step has no worked model.

Re-scored. pq1 now makes the learner evaluate each AI remark against the goal (accept one, reject one), and pq5 applies the checklist to a new plan. Neither can be answered by matching recap wording, and every wrong option has feedback. One mild cue remains: a is the only option that treats the two features differently (see niceToHave).

Re-scored. Each brief misconception is now a graded distractor with a reasoned correction of 2 sentences or fewer. Misconception 1: pq1 b 「指摘は1つずつ、目的に照らして確かめます」. Misconception 2: pq1 c 「便利さは、Mustかどうかの物差しではありません」. Misconception 3: pq1 d and pq2 d (Won't kept, not deleted). Misconception 4: pq4 a (an AI guess). One process diagram, practice-flow: 4 nodes, labels in both locales matching the expect's 「イベントの作成 → イベント一覧 → 出欠の入力 → 参加人数の一覧」. The caption states the takeaway, and alt is present. It sits after the 「それでも迷ったら」 tip with no lead-in, so its link to pc-flow is left for the learner to infer.

This is a transfer task on the learner's own idea. Each of the 6 steps has md, expect, hint and troubleshoot. There are model answers in two prompt expects and a 7-item self-check checklist (pc-goal through pc-nocode). Nothing in the steps tells the learner to turn the interview's 3-line summary into the one-sentence goal that p-interview.expect promises.
summary-points (4 points) comes after the exam. summary-next has a reflection (「受け入れなかったものがあれば、その理由を1行で」) and the next step (ch3 VS Code). There are 4 flashcards and 2 askTutor suggestions.

Re-scored. Every changed string in pq1 (prompt, 4 options, 3 feedbacks, explanation) and in pq2's options has both jp and en. Validate shows 0 errors, and lint --strict shows 0 warnings.

niceToHave: pq1 option d: the correct option a is the only one that splits the two features, so a test-wise learner can spot it. Make d split too, and keep its feedback: jp 「品物の追加はMustに残し、並べ替えはWon'tにして企画書から消す」 / en "Keep \"add items\" as a Must; make the sorting a Won't and delete it from the plan".
pq1 option a en: "keep adding items as a Must" can be read as "continue adding items". Use "Move only the sorting to Should; keep \"add items\" as a Must".

summary: This was a verification round. review-scope found 2 of 20 blocks changed (10%), with sections and objectives unchanged, so a verification is allowed. The only previous must-fix, pq1 giving its answer away and never testing misconception 1, is resolved: the AI now makes one right and one wrong remark, the correct option carries no criterion wording, and 'follow the AI' is a distractor with corrective feedback. pq2 changed only in option phrasing, and the meaning and answer are intact. align, active, miscon, accuracy, voice and a11y_l10n were re-scored, and the rest are carried over. Validate and lint --strict are clean, and there is no new must-fix.
